Group rides in California

40 recurring group rides around California: 27 road, 15 social, 10 mixed. 8 roll on weeknights, 23 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Easy Does It Sunday Ride in Chico — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? HB Velo Sunday Morning Shop Ride runs 18 mph average.
